svg.text: Copilot Chat × Fabric IQ evaluation accelerator — simplified architecture
Ask Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat, capture the DAX Fabric IQ ran, score with Option 1 (Fabric-native) or Option 2 (Microsoft Foundry Evaluations), and keep end-to-end telemetry in Fabric

Verdict per ask: a failed gate → FAIL · DAX still pending → INCONCLUSIVE · API error → ERROR · otherwise PASS.
Judge and Foundry prompt scores are reported alongside; --option both scores the same answers both ways.

Steps: 1 ask each question, then a follow-up "why"; Copilot returns the answer, citations and its explanation · 2 Copilot orchestrates Fabric IQ, which runs DAX on a semantic model · 3 the DAX comes back from workspace monitoring · 4 score with Option 1 or Option 2 · 5 telemetry to the Eventhouse · 6 OneLake to the scorecard app.
Simplified architecture: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat only. Contoso sample names. Product icons © Microsoft, used under Microsoft icon terms.
